author: Allalilacias
body:
Everytime the stable restocks (when an exclamation mark can be seen on top of it), the monsters inside are chosen by RNG from the available pool at the moment.

Accumulating more stables gives your more chances at the lottery, allowing you to get as many shots at getting whichever pet you're trying to get.

Given some pets can only be gotten in special events, it is safer to build a big amount of them to have a healthy shot at getting a good pet, since pets can really help with specific builds.
